shortDescription: Real stacked z-levels for 1.6 (sky/surface/basement) as ONE BIG MAP: live see-below view, choosable basements, full vanilla parity in work/haul/combat, wide stairs, elevators, through-gap combat (now with 1:1 vanilla shot side effects; CE support next), pod transit, opt-in threats, world integration, AUR guard, modder API.
body:
# As above, So below

## Pitch
Real, robust z-levels capped at three per column: sky above, surface, basement below — every level a real simulated map. Priorities: (1) visual clarity from the sky with a live surface view; (2) performance; (3) **full vanilla parity — the column is ONE BIG MAP, and every compat/order reads + behaves as base game**.

## Locked decisions
- Standalone C# + Harmony. Soft compat via detection/reflection, foreign types in method bodies only. ABGuard kill switches, fail open. Vanilla sentence case, ASCII only.
- Cap 3 levels. See-below / cross-gap is ONLY sky<->surface; basement routing-only. Below view PLUMB, dim slider. Things shrink about own center (belowThingScale).
- Basement environments are choosable (see BASEMENT ENVIRONMENTS). Stairwells do NOT exchange heat.
- Sky mountain: one connected rock texture per stone type; outermost ring AB_MountainTop lip; mined peak exposes open sky.
- Pod handoff LATE (22t). Mesa rejected.
- **ALWAYS `def.graphicData.Graphic`.** Settings IMGUI discipline (visibility snapshot at top of tab; deferred tab switch; reserved gutter).
- **Cross-level work: strictly-better rank; main-thread only. MIGRATION DISCIPLINE: real probe required (colonists AND robots).**
- **Cross-map job guard doctrine v2**; **FORCED-ORDER PARITY PATTERN**; **NATIVE FLOAT MENU POLICY**; **SEAMLESS CONTINUATION DOCTRINE**; **CAMERA LEVEL LOCK = HARD**; **IsPlayerHome column identity** (ColumnAsHome, load-bearing for hauling-mod compat).
- **FOREIGN-MAP ELIGIBILITY GATE**: z-levels excluded from foreign special maps (first consumer: AUR submaps). Fail-open. Two choke points: PlaceWorker_ABStairs + LevelMapGen.GetOrGenerate.
- **TEXTURE POLICY**: user supplies stair art. **PARITY AUDIT = ROADMAP** (docs/).

## CROSS-LEVEL COMBAT (Model B, through-the-gap ranged) — files in Source/Combat/
Vanilla has no third dimension, so a projectile lives on one 2D map and vanilla refuses a cross-map cast. Robust workaround: spawn the projectile on the TARGET's map so flight/armour/impact/damage/rendering are 100% vanilla on the receiving map. Only target acquisition (line-of-fire + range across the gap) and the launch are custom. Direct verbs (guns, autocannons) use sky-plane LoF; ARC verbs (mortars) lob over via open-air holes. Pawn shooters run JobDriver_ABCrossLevelAttack; turrets run a tick-accurate warmup->burst->cooldown driver (CrossLevelTurret) with its own cross-map target store (vanilla clears forced targets cross-map). AI auto-engage (CrossLevelAutoEngage) at vanilla cadence: hostiles shoot up, drafted colonists return fire. All gated by ABGuard.Combat + crossLevelCombat setting, fail-open.

### VANILLA SHOT PARITY (ABShotEffects.cs) — added 2026-07-23
The hand-rolled launch bypassed the whole cast pipeline (Verb.TryCastNextBurstShot -> Verb_LaunchProjectile.TryCastShot -> Verb_Shoot.WarmupComplete), so it was missing every book-keeping side effect. ABShotEffects now replays them 1:1 so a cross-gap shot is indistinguishable from a same-map shot:
- **Per shot** (OnShotFired, called inside Fire/FireArcShot after launch): soundCast at shooter + **soundCastTail on camera (the missing echo)**; the **ShotFlash muzzle fleck** at muzzleFlashScale; pawn combat notifies (Notify_UsedVerb, mindState engaged/attacked via cached Harmony open-delegates since those are internal, MentalState.Notify_AttackedTarget, health.Notify_UsedVerb, EquipmentSource.Notify_UsedWeapon); ShotsFired record; CompChangeableProjectile unload + CompApparelVerbOwner_Charged discharge; consumeFuelPerShot.
- **On the spawned projectile** (ApplyWeaponTraits, before Launch): CompUniqueWeapon damageDefOverride + extraDamages (persona weapons).
- **Per burst** (OnBurstWarmupComplete, at aim-complete): BattleLogEntry_RangedFire combat-log entry (all shooters); **Shooting XP** (Verb_Shoot rule: 170x cycle vs hostile / 20x friendly, live non-mech pawn targets only) for pawn shooters. Turrets get the log but no XP (caster is the building). Fires even if the committed shot whiffs, matching vanilla.
Turret driver's old direct CompChangeableProjectile.Notify_ProjectileLaunched calls were removed (now folded into OnShotFired to avoid double-unload). All effects swallow-safe: a notify can never abort a shot that already left the barrel.

### COMBAT EXTENDED SUPPORT — PLANNED (Phase 2, not yet built)
CE reality (decompiled CombatExtended.dll 1.6): **Verb_LaunchProjectileCE : Verb** (NOT Verb_LaunchProjectile) and **ProjectileCE : ThingWithComps** (NOT Verse.Projectile). So GetRangedVerb (tests `is Verb_LaunchProjectile`) returns null for every CE weapon -> cross-level RANGED combat is currently **silently inert with CE** (no crash; CE pawns/turrets just can't shoot the gap, they'd walk the stairs). Melee still routes fine.
Plan: reuse the existing geometry/LoF model verbatim (verb-agnostic), add CE detection, spawn a **ProjectileCE** on the target map and launch via CE's `ProjectileCE.Launch(launcher, origin, shotAngle, shotRotation, shotHeight, shotSpeed, equipment, distance)` — shotHeight is an elevation lever ideal for plunging sky->surface fire; full CE armour/pen/suppression/damage on the receiving map. **Decided fidelity: simpler cut** — use our existing aim roll for hit/miss, let CE ballistics+armour+suppression handle downstream (no ShiftVecReport spread/sway/recoil yet). **Ammo: PARITY** — consume magazine ammo via CompAmmoUser. Packaging: isolated compat assembly hard-referencing CombatExtended.dll, loaded via LoadFolders `<li IfModActive="CETeam.CombatExtended">`, CE types in method bodies / object-typed signatures only (dodge the dev-palette TypeLoadException per soft-compat lore).

## BUILDING ART — FINALIZED 2026-07-23
Directional art set (_north/_east/_south; east auto-mirrors west). NO uiIconPath on stair defs (icon auto-derives from SOUTH face). Baked drawSize/offsets folded into AB_Stairs.xml. Dev art tuner removed.

## SEE-BELOW view (BelowSelection / LevelRenderer / BelowThingOverlays)
Plumb one-way mirror; select in place; double-click select-all-of-type; below overlays (GUI stack counts/quality + world-space forbid icons via reflected overlayHandles). Fail-open.

## BASEMENT ENVIRONMENTS (BasementEnv registry + gensteps) — reworked 2026-07-23
Unified `basementType` setting (replaces the old cavernBasements bool; one-time migration via `basementMigrated`, old default caverns-on carried forward). Single Generation-tab selector; options filtered by loaded mods (BasementEnv.AvailableOptions/Sanitize). AB_Basement genSteps: AB_SolidRock -> AB_CavernCarve -> AB_UrbanRuins (last two mutually exclusive by settings, both no-op otherwise). Types:
- **SolidRock** (default): vanilla mineable rock fill (GenStep_ABSolidRock) + ore veins.
- **Caverns** (Biomes! Caverns only): worm-carved living cavern via GenStep_ABCavernCarve; cavernBiome sub-picker (random weighted or specific BMT_ biome); BC-only stalagmite/crystal dressing. (BC stalagmite scatterer emits a KNOWN-BENIGN "could not find cell to generate at" warning occasionally - expected, ignore.)
- **Foreign biome carve** (curated): GenStep_ABCavernCarve GENERALIZED 2026-07-23 to carve ANY BiomeDef (biome swap on pocketTileInfo + terrain-by-fertility + flora + fauna are generic reads; BC dressing gated to Caverns type). Curated list (BasementEnv.ForeignCarveBiomes, shown only when the biome def exists): **AB_MycoticJungle** (fungal), **AB_GelatinousSuperorganism** (living flesh), **AB_RockyCrags** (forsaken crags, raw rock), **AB_TarPits** (oily sump) — all Alpha Biomes. Temperature caveat: pocket maps use the biome's fixed temp. Openness + chamber sliders apply to all carve types; formations Caverns-only. (ReGrowth 2 has NO cave biome; Vanilla Biomes Expanded not installed.)
- **UrbanRuins** (Ancient urban ruins only): GenStep_ABUrbanRuins -> AncientUrbanRuinsCompat.TryStampFacility. Solid-rock fill, then a random UNDERGROUND facility stamped CENTERED (colonists mine to it). Reflection into AUR's static MapGeneratingUtility, called piecewise so occupants are optional. **urbanRuinsOccupants toggle, default ON**. **Stair functionality stripped**: map-portal buildings filtered out of thingDatas before SpawnThings (prevents the vanilla PocketMapExit portal log). Fail-open to solid rock.
- **REVEAL ON LOAD** (`basementRevealed`, default ON): LevelComp.FinalizeInit calls fogGrid.ClearAllFog() for level==-1 maps so the whole basement is visible without mining. Off = explore normally.

## HAULING MOD COMPAT (Scope B) — PUAH + HD user-verified
ABInventoryHaulBridge -> CrossLevelHaulJob.Build (bulk vs single) -> JobDriver_ABBulkHaulAcrossLevels + WorkGiver. Allow Tool urgent hauling crosses first.

## ANCIENT URBAN RUINS COMPAT (AncientUrbanRuinsCompat.cs) — 2026-07-23
Host `XMB.AncientUrbanrUins.MO`. Reflection only, fail-open. AUR submaps are pocket maps via AUR's own portal system.
- **Eligibility guard (direction A)**: z-levels excluded from AUR submaps by default. `allowLevelsOnUrbanRuins` (default OFF, Compat tab) opts in.
- **Basement stamping** (see BASEMENT ENVIRONMENTS): TryStampFacility + SpawnThingsNoPortals + StripPortals.

## VERIFIED BASELINE (run #62 and prior; basement rework partially verified run #86)
Priority-aware work; select in place; right-click orders; merged colonist bar; stairs/elevators; work/haul/supply/needs/medical/prisoners; see-below renderer; through-gap combat; pod transit + AA; caravans; opt-in threats; world integration; wealth; rituals; social; camera lock; naturalistic peaks; BC caverns; sky biome inheritance; MO formations; BM variant mode; modder API. PUAH/HD bulk hauling + Allow Tool urgent tested good.

## SETTINGS — SEVEN tabs: Generation / View and camera / Work and logistics / Job scanning / Combat and threats / Compat / Advanced.
- Generation tab: peaks/preview, ore, basement-environment selector + per-type sub-options + reveal-on-load toggle, landmarks.
- Compat tab (index 5): per-mod integration options; AUR allowLevelsOnUrbanRuins.

## Dev-tools — ensure sky+basement; self-test suite; below-view diagnostic.

## Compat
DBH/VEF/Rimefeller/VCHE risers. Biomes! Caverns (soft). Alpha Biomes (soft, 4 curated basement biomes). BM + MO (verified). Odyssey landmarks + VLE (soft). Misc. Robots + Robots++ (verified). Hauler's Dream + Pick Up And Haul (bulk, user-verified). Allow Tool. Ancient urban ruins (z-levels excluded from AUR submaps by default; AUR facilities selectable as a basement environment). **Combat Extended: cross-level ranged currently INERT (Phase 2 pending) — parity shot-effects layer (ABShotEffects) is vanilla-only for now.** Achtung!/Reverse Commands/Giddy-up/Vehicle Framework/Windows/Declutter/Animal Tab/Colonist Bar KF (soft). INCOMPAT: MultiFloors, Z-Levels Beta. UNSUPPORTED: RimThreaded.

## Status
2026-07-23: **Phase 1 of combat parity done** — ABShotEffects.cs replays the full vanilla cast pipeline for cross-level shots (soundCast+tail, ShotFlash muzzle fleck, combat-log entry, Shooting XP, ShotsFired record, pawn mind/mental/health/weapon notifies, CompUniqueWeapon traits, changeable/charged unload, fuel). Wired into Fire/FireArcShot + pawn JobDriver burst-warmup + turret warmup phase. Build green (0/0). Pending in-game verification (check: shot echo/tail audible, muzzle flash, cross-gap shots in combat log, colonists gain shooting skill sniping across the gap). **Phase 2 next: Combat Extended cross-level support** (spawn ProjectileCE on target map via CE Launch w/ shotHeight; simpler-cut accuracy; PARITY ammo consumption; isolated LoadFolders-gated compat assembly). Earlier today: basement-environment rework, reveal-on-load, AUR facility basement, see-below overlays. Outstanding chores: verify combat parity in-game, basement environments + reveal + AUR gate, translation report audit, palette pin watch, mech escort test, settings preview pass, VCHE run, soak, publishing prep.
